svg.title: My GitHub contributions over the last year, drawn as a city by day along the tracks, in a valley between two pine-topped rock hills: one tower a week, one window a day. A commuter train runs through the year, and each week's windows light up as it passes, brighter on busier days. 3,181 contributions, longest streak 67 days, busiest Oct 9 (170).

g.text: 3,181 contributions · longest streak 67 days · busiest Oct 9 (170)
